items.title: Steam forum ClickFix attacks infect gamers with XMRig cryptominers
items.description: Steam discussion forums are being abused in ClickFix attacks that pretend to be fixes for game and computer problems but actually infect devices with cryptominers. [...]

items.title: Malvertising Sends Malware in Pieces, Then Makes the Browser Build the Executable
items.description: A malvertising operation dubbed SourTrade is making victims' browsers build the final Windows executable themselves, using a legitimate Bun runtime as its base instead of serving one complete malicious file from a fixed URL. items.title: GitLab Vulnerabilities Allow Attackers to Execute Remote Code on Default GitLab Installations
items.description: A newly disclosed exploit chain in GitLab shows how two long-buried memory-safety flaws in a Ruby JSON parsing library, Oj, could be combined to achieve remote code execution on default GitLab installations, exposing source code, Rails secrets, and internal services.
